exposure: Preoperative vaginal antiseptic cleansing with povidone-iodine
cohort: 180 women undergoing emergency caesarean sections at the University of Ilorin teaching hospital were randomized into intervention and control groups.
finding: Preoperative vaginal preparation with povidone-iodine significantly reduced the incidence of post-caesarean section infectious morbidity, specifically fever and endometritis, compared to standard abdominal scrub alone.
mod_finding: Vaginal cleaning with Povidone-iodine significantly reduced post-caesarean fever and endometritis for women undergoing emergency caesarean section.
